rulesStrings.li: r_line->[PAWN_nameDef] falls first. Someone always has to.
r_line->The first blood of the day belongs to [PAWN_nameDef].
r_line(timesDowned>=3)->[PAWN_nameDef] is down again. The ground knows [PAWN_objective] by name now.
r_line(veteran==True)->[kills] enemies have fallen to [PAWN_nameDef]. Today the ground takes [PAWN_objective] first.
r_line(hasOther==True)->[OTHER_nameDef] draws first blood. [PAWN_nameDef] will remember that face.
r_line(hasLover==True)->[PAWN_nameDef] goes down, and somewhere in the colony a heart skips.
r_line(storyteller==Randy)->[PAWN_nameDef] is down. Bad luck. Hilarious, but bad.
r_line(storyteller==Phoebe)->[PAWN_nameDef] falls. Rest, if only for a moment.
r_line(storyteller==Cassandra)->The first to fall is [PAWN_nameDef]. The pattern begins.
r_line->[PAWN_nameDef] is gone. The colony is smaller now, and quieter.
r_line->Mark the place. [PAWN_nameDef] fell here.
r_line(hasOther==True)->[OTHER_nameDef] took [PAWN_nameDef] from us. Remember that name.
r_line(veteran==True)->[kills] foes fell to [PAWN_nameDef]. In the end, one was enough.
r_line(hasLover==True)->[PAWN_nameDef] dies, and someone will wait at a door that will not open.
r_line(timesDowned>=2)->[PAWN_nameDef] got back up [timesDowned] times. Not this time.
r_line(storyteller==Randy)->[PAWN_nameDef] is dead. The dice do not care. They never did.
r_line(storyteller==Phoebe)->Sleep now, [PAWN_nameDef]. You did enough.
r_line(storyteller==Cassandra)->[PAWN_nameDef] falls, and the story tightens around those who remain.
r_line->[PAWN_nameDef] cuts the head from the serpent. [OTHER_nameDef] will lead no one again.
r_line->[OTHER_nameDef] came to conquer. [PAWN_nameDef] had other plans.
r_line(veteran==True)->One more for [PAWN_nameDef], and the one that mattered most.
r_line(storyteller==Randy)->[PAWN_nameDef] kills [OTHER_nameDef]. A promotion opens up in the enemy ranks.
r_line(storyteller==Phoebe)->[OTHER_nameDef] falls. Maybe now the rest will go home.
r_line(storyteller==Cassandra)->Their leader is dead. Watch the rest begin to doubt.
r_line->[PAWN_nameDef] rises. Not finished. Not yet.
r_line->Blood in [PAWN_possessive] mouth, [PAWN_nameDef] finds [PAWN_possessive] feet again.
r_line(timesDowned>=3)->Down [timesDowned] times, and still [PAWN_nameDef] stands up.
r_line(storyteller==Randy)->[PAWN_nameDef] gets back up. Nobody expected that, least of all [PAWN_nameDef].
r_line(storyteller==Phoebe)->[PAWN_nameDef] stands. Slowly. Carefully. Still here.
r_line(storyteller==Cassandra)->[PAWN_nameDef] refuses the ending written for [PAWN_objective].
r_line->The attackers break. [count] of them lie still, and [PAWN_nameDef] is still breathing.
r_line->It is over. [PAWN_nameDef] lowers [PAWN_possessive] weapon and listens to the silence.
r_line(veteran==True)->Another day survived. [PAWN_nameDef] has stopped counting. We have not: [kills].
r_line(storyteller==Randy)->Victory. Nobody planned it, and it worked anyway.
r_line(storyteller==Phoebe)->The fighting stops. Tend the wounded. Bury the dead. Breathe.
r_line(storyteller==Cassandra)->They are beaten, for now. They will remember this place.
